name: Sahifa API
description:
HTML to PDF and screenshot API hosted in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Compatible with PDFShift v3 (POST /v3/convert/pdf) and ScreenshotOne (/take).

**Data residency and compliance.** Every request is processed on servers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Oracle Cloud, me-jeddah-1). Request content and rendered documents are never stored and never leave the Kingdom. This supports the customer-data residency expectations of the SAMA Cyber Security Framework and of Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). Data processing agreement: https://sahifa.dev/en/dpa. What runs where: https://sahifa.dev/en/data-residency

**Authentication.** Send your API key in the X-API-Key header. For drop-in compatibility, /v3/convert/pdf also accepts PDFShift-style Basic auth, and /take accepts the ScreenshotOne-style access_key parameter.

**Retries and idempotency.** Retrying is safe: a render has no side effects and nothing is stored, so a repeated request never creates a duplicate. Retry 408, 429 and 503 with an increasing wait (for example 2, 4 and 8 seconds); do not retry other 4xx errors.

**Limits.** Each plan has a monthly render allowance (Sandbox keys also a daily one), reported on every response in the X-Quota-* headers; a used-up allowance answers 402. Concurrent renders are queued, and a full queue answers 429. Details: https://sahifa.dev/en/docs/limits

Pricing: https://sahifa.dev/en/pricing · Changelog: https://sahifa.dev/en/docs/changelog · Status: https://stats.uptimerobot.com/5fFpK4UvT9
